objective: Complete the requested consistency review in the current docs/md/spec.md candidate so the granular availability model and the four orthogonal concepts—administrative state, structural eligibility, operational availability, and review state—form one implementable textual solution.

decisions.decision: Use only docs/md/spec.md as a writable target; it exists, so the operation is MODIFY.

Use the confirmed review-state vocabulary UP_TO_DATE and REVIEW_REQUIRED. Remove NONE as an invented review-state value and apply the confirmed pair consistently wherever the review lifecycle is enumerated.

Preserve the established granular availability semantics: leaf availability is determined at MenuItemVariant; ModifierAvailability is contextual to a variant and may limit an optional ModifierOption without automatically blocking the variant; mandatory restrictions must remain satisfiable by at least one valid configuration.

Keep ComboOption availability derived from its referenced leaf MenuItemVariant, ComboConfiguration availability dependent on every required ComboSlot satisfying its minimum through currently selectable options, and MenuItem availability as a non-authoritative aggregate projection.
Treat the current version 1.1.5 metadata as the version for this run. Do not introduce a new version solely for correcting this audit round.

invariants: Do not rename or renumber any REQ-* identifier.
Do not introduce new capabilities, patterns, states, or availability rules.
Do not redraw diagrams for style; retain semantic inconsistency notes for the later diagram run.
Do not synchronize translations, generated outputs, interfaces, UI specifications, or historical artifacts.
Do not perform unrelated cosmetic cleanup.
Operational availability must not mutate administrative state, structural eligibility, review state, prices, or immutable commercial revisions.
No file other than docs/md/spec.md may be modified.

instructions: Review the current candidate across functional requirements, business rules, invariants, domain and data models, states, contracts, events, and service dependencies, changing only residual statements that contradict the availability and orthogonality decisions in request.md.

Replace NONE with UP_TO_DATE wherever reviewStatus is enumerated, including the orthogonality table and the deferred state-diagram inconsistency note. Make the normative glossary and any entity/data descriptions that enumerate reviewStatus use the same UP_TO_DATE/REVIEW_REQUIRED pair without creating another state or OPEN item.

Preserve the distinction between administrative status, structural eligibility, operational availability, and reviewStatus; ensure none is presented as an alias, subtype, or automatic mutation of another.

Preserve VariantAvailability as existential satisfiability of at least one complete valid configuration against net demand. An unavailable optional ModifierOption may be limited or blocked independently; the variant becomes unavailable only when mandatory restrictions cannot be satisfied or no complete valid configuration remains.

Preserve ModifierAvailability and availableMaxQuantity in the context of (variantId, modifierOptionId), ComboOption availability as derived from its referenced leaf variant, ComboConfiguration availability as satisfaction of each required slot minimum by selectable options, and MenuItem availability as a derived catalog aggregate rather than an authoritative operational state.

Remove trailing whitespace from the newly added deferred-diagram note blocks around sections 7.5 and 8.1. Use valid Markdown blockquote structure or ordinary wrapped lines instead of two-space line endings; do not normalize unrelated pre-existing whitespace elsewhere.
Keep the current v1.1.5 identification/history accurate for this same consistency run and preserve existing anchors, section links, and requirement identifiers.

Verify the final delta is limited to docs/md/spec.md; search for remaining uses of NONE as reviewStatus, inspect all UP_TO_DATE/REVIEW_REQUIRED definitions for consistency, and run git diff --check -- docs/md/spec.md.
acceptance: docs/md/spec.md consistently uses UP_TO_DATE and REVIEW_REQUIRED for reviewStatus and contains no remaining NONE value for that lifecycle.
The availability rules remain coherent across requirements, rules, invariants, domain/data models, contracts, events, and dependency descriptions.
Optional personalization availability does not automatically block a variant; mandatory satisfiability and complete-configuration existence govern VariantAvailability.
Combo and aggregate MenuItem availability remain derived exactly as specified in request.md.
Administrative state, eligibility, availability, and review state remain explicitly orthogonal with no conceptual duplication.
Deferred diagram inconsistencies remain identified without diagram redesign, and the edited note blocks contain no trailing whitespace.
No REQ-* identifier is renamed or renumbered, no new capability or pattern is introduced, and no file outside docs/md/spec.md changes.
git diff --check -- docs/md/spec.md reports no errors for the candidate delta.
